scripts.build: npm run buildDev && npm run buildStaging && npm run buildProd
scripts.buildProd: npm run generate && ../../node_modules/.bin/ng build homepage --configuration production --base-href / --output-path homepage/client/dist/prod
scripts.buildStaging: npm run generate && ../../node_modules/.bin/ng build homepage --configuration staging --base-href / --output-path homepage/client/dist/staging
scripts.buildDev: npm run generate && ../../node_modules/.bin/ng build homepage --configuration development --base-href / --output-path homepage/client/dist/dev
scripts.generate: npm run generateCommonTypings && npm run generateLapTypings && npm run scss2json && npm run generateEnvFiles
